create_ParticleModel: create a ParticleModel distribution over N particles in a D-dimensional box with periodic boundary conditions
create_FlowModel: create a FlowModel that transforms a base ParticleModel through a Distrax bijector flow
create_TranslationInvariant: create a TranslationInvariant model that adds a random uniform shift to make a base model translation invariant
create_Lattice: create a Lattice-based particle model that samples particles by adding noise to lattice sites with random permutation
create_FaceCentredCubicLattice: create a FaceCentredCubicLattice model that samples particles from an FCC lattice with spherically truncated Gaussian noise
